features.summary: Audio sink behavior during seeks was improved so the seek-resume clock stays aligned to the audible position, and the implementation reuses the audio stream across a seek instead of recreating it (with logic to recreate if the stream dies while resuming). The result is fewer glitches and smoother resume behavior when seeking in audio or video with separate audio sinks.

patches.subject: Bug 2022257. Propagate the exception when an ArrayBuffer transfer fails in ImageDecoder instead of storing a bogus pointer.

features.summary: WebCodecs/ImageDecoder received several safety and correctness fixes: initialization was hardened against reentrant calls, cropping now only swizzles (reorders color bytes) for the visible rect on RGBA-backed VideoFrames, and ArrayBuffer transfer failures in ImageDecoder now propagate exceptions instead of leaving bogus pointers. These changes reduce crashes and data-corruption risks when using WebCodecs, VideoFrame, and ImageDecoder APIs.

features.summary: Recent updates in the Fake Cdm area have focused on enhancing code efficiency by removing the unused `sShutdownMode` global in the `cdm-test-decryptor.cpp` file. This change helps streamline the testing environment for Content Decryption Modules (CDM), which are essential for managing the playback of DRM-protected content. While this update does not bring any direct changes to user-facing features, it contributes to a cleaner and more maintainable codebase, ensuring smoother functionality in handling media formats.

features.label: Media encoders

patches.author: Chun-Min Chang
patches.subject: Use TimeDuration::ToTicksAtRate in VideoTrackEncoder

features.summary: Recent updates to the media encoders in Firefox have refined how video encoding manages timing. Specifically, the introduction of the **TimeDuration::ToTicksAtRate** function in the VideoTrackEncoder enhances the precision of timing calculations during video encoding processes. This improvement is crucial because accurate timing ensures smoother playback and better synchronization of audio and video streams, making for a more seamless viewing experience for users. Overall, these changes help elevate the quality of video processing in the browser.

features.label: WebM

patches.author: Sylvestre Ledru
patches.subject: Fix bugprone-fold-init-type warnings in WebMDemuxer::GetNextPacket

features.summary: Recent updates in the WebM area have addressed warnings related to the handling of media data, specifically in the WebMDemuxer, which is responsible for reading and extracting packets of audio and video from WebM files. By fixing these warnings, the Firefox browser improves its efficiency and reliability when processing WebM content. While users may not notice a visible change, this work ensures a smoother experience when streaming or playing WebM-formatted videos, which are commonly used for web media.
